rows.corpus_definition: unable to stop doing something because you need it very much
rows.example_en: He is addicted to playing video games every single night.

rows.corpus_definition: A feeling of deep respect and liking.
rows.example_en: I have great admiration for your talent.

rows.corpus_definition: To respect someone for something good they have done.
rows.example_en: I admire her for her hard work.

rows.corpus_definition: to say that something is true, especially when you are unhappy.
rows.example_en: He had to admit his mistake to the teacher.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who gives help and suggestions.
rows.example_en: The financial adviser helped me save.

rows.corpus_definition: A warm, loving feeling for someone.
rows.example_en: He showed great affection for his pet dog.

rows.corpus_definition: not too expensive for people to buy

rows.corpus_definition: A business that provides a service for others.
rows.example_en: They hired a travel agency to plan trips.

rows.corpus_definition: a situation where two or more people share the same opinion or decision
rows.example_en: They finally reached an agreement about the plans.

rows.corpus_definition: Any vehicle that can fly through the air.
rows.example_en: The military aircraft flew over the city.
